allowedVariants.description: If set, only resolved code-variants in this list will be loaded by the game.

class.description: A reference to the registered C# class of the object. Can be used to add extra functionality to objects.

enabled.description: If set to false, this object will not be loaded.

skipVariants.description: A set of resolved code-variants that will not be loaded by the game

variantGroups.description: All available variants for this object

interactions.description: (Currently unused) A set of potential world interactions for this object. Used to display what the object is used for - e.g. Shift + Right Click to Knap Stones.
